footnotes: The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 51.3% to $183M in 2025. Operating income fell 5.7% to $32.0M, a 17.5% margin.
Net income rose 3.9× to $39.9M, or $0.37 per share. Operating cash flow was $125M and free cash flow $125M, versus $54.3M; Curbline returned $77.4M through dividends.
sources: Curbline Properties Corp. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
